ModMetaData.name: RimScent Extended: Weather Expansion
ModMetaData.author: nelim
ModMetaData.description:
Weather, disasters, and the air outside.
WHAT IS IN IT TODAY The events of Vanilla Events Expanded that reach the nose. GameConditionDef is one of the def types RimScent's own extension already accepts, and Vanilla Events Expanded never used a single one of them.
- Drought: dust and dry ground, cracked earth, nothing green left to smell. - Heat wave: hot air carries everything with it, and none of it is pleasant. - Psychic bloom: something floral and wrong, too sweet to be a flower.
WHAT IS COMING Rain and wet earth, forest and cut grass, warm mud at the water's edge, the sea, hot springs. Unwashed colonists through Dubs Bad Hygiene — a pawn who does not wash smells, unlike an animal, which does. Pheromones, which nobody notices consciously and everybody notices. Illness on the breath.
This is the thinnest of the RimScent Extended family today, and the one with the most room to grow.
Ships in English with a French translation injected on top. Vanilla Events Expanded support loads only if that mod is active. No save data.
Requires RimScent and RimScent Extended.
